item.coloph: ces pa'ang rgyal kun 'dus zhabs pad ma g.yung drung sngags kyi 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar snying po bcud du dril don shar phyogs rgyal mo dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse nas hu chen 'gro 'dul pad ma gling pa'i (pas) gter zhal phyes cing slar lo lnga'i bka' rgya yol phye (tshe) gnas mchog phyug mo dpal ri'i mdun zhol dga' ldan dar rgyas gling du shog ser la zhal bshus pas dge legs su gyur cig/
